name: Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
role: President of the United Arab Emirates (since 2022); Crown Prince and de facto ruler of Abu Dhabi (2004-2022)
summary: Rules the UAE as a dynastic, centralised state with banned parties, and has led its campaign against Muslim Brotherhood-linked groups and Wahhabi influence. He promotes an open, diverse, business-friendly and tolerance-branded country with a strong military and close ties to the US, with heavy investment in climate, technology and education.
